title: Composite likelihood methods
annotation: Defines composite likelihoods, sums of log likelihoods of marginal or conditional events, and their estimating equations; the product of pairwise transition densities used on the likelihood page is one.

authors: Self, S. G. and Liang, K.-Y.
title: Asymptotic properties of maximum likelihood estimators and likelihood ratio tests under nonstandard conditions
venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association 82(398):605-610
annotation: The asymptotic law of likelihood ratio and score tests when the true parameter is on the boundary of the parameter space: a mixture of chi-square laws from projecting the Gaussian score onto the tangent cone.

title: Towards a unified theory of inequality constrained testing in multivariate analysis
annotation: Chi-bar-square distributions for tests of inequality constraints, with the weights given by the probabilities that the projection of a Gaussian vector onto a cone lands on each face.
